name: The Ferry Office
description: Runtime source scene for the current Ferry Office, service-yard, dock-road, and first driver/fixer job prototype.

authoringNotes: Runtime scene loading uses this file for layout, markers, interactables, traversal, vehicle data, and mesh instances.
Tidebreak-specific gameplay meaning remains in C++ scene/job code; this file is not a mission script.
Keep ids stable and lowercase-kebab-case so Codex tools can compare scene data against code/docs.
